overview: Build a minifigure-scale Jedi with blond hair, white outfit, and a blue lightsaber. Split into 5 sub-assemblies: legs/hips, torso/belt, head, hair, and lightsaber/arms pose.

subassemblies.name: Legs & hips
subassemblies.description: 1 minifigure lower-body block: 2 legs with 2 feet, plus 1 hips/waist connection to the torso (white outfit look; add 2 small tan/gold accents on the outer thighs if desired).

subassemblies.name: Torso & belt
subassemblies.description: 1 torso block in white: 1 chest/robe front, 1 back, 1 belt band across the waist (dark red/brown), plus 1 neck connection on top.
subassemblies.imageRegion: middle of figure, slightly left of center

subassemblies.name: Arms & hands (saber grip pose)
subassemblies.description: 2 arms (white sleeves) and 2 hands (light tan). Pose both hands together in front of the torso to hold the hilt; include 1 small internal shoulder/brace structure to keep the hands aligned in a 2-handed grip.

subassemblies.name: Head
subassemblies.description: 1 head: 1 face block (light tan) with 2 eyes/eyebrows and 1 mouth/chin detail (use small plates/tiles for facial features).

subassemblies.name: Hair + lightsaber
subassemblies.description: 1 blond hair mass: layered, swept hair shape over the head (use sloped/curved pieces). 1 lightsaber: 1 cylindrical hilt (silver/gray) and 1 blue blade extending upward-right.
